criterion: The production-equivalent target-build p95 response time must be at most 2.0 seconds.
explanation: The acceptance criterion requires production-environment verification of p95 latency ≤ 2.0s. REC-6024 (production) shows 1.40s meeting the threshold via comment 10745, while REC-1028 (staging) is irrelevant for production scope as stated in comment 11729. Developer status updates in REQ-04 are superseded by explicit production results in REC-6024.

evidence.excerpt: Performance run PERF-827: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment production; prompt p7. Measured p95 latency 1.40 seconds across 1000 requests.
evidence.why: Production environment p95 latency 1.40s ≤ 2.0s for R2.4/b7a91f2/p7

evidence.excerpt: Performance run PERF-812: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment staging; prompt p7. Measured p95 latency 2.60 seconds across 1000 requests on the shared staging cluster.
evidence.why: Staging environment results (2.60s) do not satisfy production scope requirement
